description: Create, destroy, update, start, stop, and reboot a 1&1 Host server. When the server is created it can optionally wait for it to be ‘running’ before returning.

parameters.name: api_url
parameters.description: Custom API URL. Overrides the ONEANDONE_API_URL environment variable.

parameters.name: appliance
parameters.description: The operating system name or ID for the server. It is required only for ‘present’ state.

parameters.name: auth_token
parameters.description: Authenticating API token provided by 1&1. Overrides the ONEANDONE_AUTH_TOKEN environment variable.

parameters.name: auto_increment
parameters.description: When creating multiple servers at once, whether to differentiate hostnames by appending a count after them or substituting the count where there is a %02d or %03d in the hostname string. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: cores_per_processor
parameters.description: The number of cores per processor. It must be provided with vcore, ram, and hdds parameters.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of servers to create. Default: 1

parameters.name: datacenter
parameters.description: The datacenter location. Choices: "US" ← (default) "ES" "DE" "GB"

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: The description of the server.

parameters.name: firewall_policy
parameters.description: The firewall policy name or ID.

parameters.name: fixed_instance_size
parameters.description: The instance size name or ID of the server. It is required only for ‘present’ state, and it is mutually exclusive with vcore, cores_per_processor, ram, and hdds parameters. The available choices are: S, M, L, XL, XXL, 3XL, 4XL, 5XL.

parameters.name: hdds
parameters.description: A list of hard disks with nested hdds[].size and hdds[].is_main properties. It must be provided with vcore, cores_per_processor, and ram parameters.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: The hostname or ID of the server. Only used when state is ‘present’.

parameters.name: load_balancer
parameters.description: The load balancer name or ID.

parameters.name: monitoring_policy
parameters.description: The monitoring policy name or ID.

parameters.name: private_network
parameters.description: The private network name or ID.

parameters.name: ram
parameters.description: The amount of RAM memory. It must be provided with with vcore, cores_per_processor, and hdds parameters.

parameters.name: server
parameters.description: Server identifier (ID or hostname). It is required for all states except ‘running’ and ‘present’.

parameters.name: server_type
parameters.description: The type of server to be built. Choices: "cloud" ← (default) "baremetal" "k8s_node"

parameters.name: ssh_key
parameters.description: User’s public SSH key (contents, not path).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Define a server’s state to create, remove, start or stop it. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent" "running" "stopped"

parameters.name: vcore
parameters.description: The total number of processors. It must be provided with cores_per_processor, ram, and hdds parameters.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Wait for the server to be in state ‘running’ before returning. Also used for delete operation (set to false if you do not want to wait for each individual server to be deleted before moving on with other tasks). Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: wait_interval
parameters.description: Defines the number of seconds to wait when using the wait_for methods. Default: 5

parameters.name: wait_timeout
parameters.description: How long before wait gives up, in seconds. Default: 600

examples:
- name: Create three servers and enumerate their names
  community.general.oneandone_server:
    auth_token: oneandone_private_api_key
    hostname: node%02d
    fixed_instance_size: XL
    datacenter: US
    appliance: C5A349786169F140BCBC335675014C08
    auto_increment: true
    count: 3

- name: Create three servers, passing in an ssh_key
  community.general.oneandone_server:
    auth_token: oneandone_private_api_key
    hostname: node%02d
    vcore: 2
    cores_per_processor: 4
    ram: 8.0
    hdds:
      - size: 50
        is_main: false
    datacenter: ES
    appliance: C5A349786169F140BCBC335675014C08
    count: 3
    wait: true
    wait_timeout: 600
    wait_interval: 10
    ssh_key: SSH_PUBLIC_KEY

- name: Removing server
  community.general.oneandone_server:
    auth_token: oneandone_private_api_key
    state: absent
    server: 'node01'

- name: Starting server
  community.general.oneandone_server:
    auth_token: oneandone_private_api_key
    state: running
    server: 'node01'

- name: Stopping server
  community.general.oneandone_server:
    auth_token: oneandone_private_api_key
    state: stopped
    server: 'node01'

return_values.name: servers
return_values.description: Information about each server that was processed. Returned: always Sample: [{"hostname": "my-server", "id": "server-id"}]
